tools.name: risetive_get_product_profile
tools.description: Read one listed software product by its domain: what it does, its main features, monthly visits, backlinks, referring domains, pricing (paid/free/gated, starting price, model) and its niche with its rank there. Use it after risetive_find_competitors or risetive_list_niche_players to look at one prod

tools.name: risetive_list_niche_players
tools.description: List up to eight leading products in one niche — current top products first, then by monthly visits — each with its one-line description, monthly visits, referring domains and pricing. Use it to see who leads a niche; use risetive_list_new_entrants for the newest products in it. No pagination. Works

tools.name: risetive_list_new_entrants
tools.description: List up to ten products most recently added to Risetive in one niche, newest first, with the same fields as risetive_list_niche_players and when each was added. Use it to see who just entered a niche; the added date is when Risetive listed the product, not its launch date. Works without signing in (

tools.name: risetive_save_item
tools.description: Save a niche or a product to the signed-in user's Risetive Saved list (risetive.com/saved). Pass kind and key: kind "market" with a niche slug as key, or kind "product" with a product id (from risetive_get_product_profile, risetive_list_niche_players or risetive_list_new_entrants) as key. tools.name: risetive_list_saved_items
tools.description: List the niches and products the signed-in user saved, with each item's id (pass it as savedItemId to risetive_remove_saved_item). Only the user's own items. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.

tools.name: risetive_remove_saved_item
tools.description: Remove one item from the signed-in user's Saved list by the id that risetive_save_item or risetive_list_saved_items returns; the niche, product or project itself is not affected. Removing an item that is already gone returns removed: false. Requires signing in with a free Risetive account.
